get.description: Export all matching safe projected events, at most 10,000 rows. Over-limit requests fail without truncation. Calendar dates use the institutional timezone.

Current notices for this account.

``pending_acknowledgment=true`` narrows the list to notices that still ask this account for an
acknowledgment, so the portal can find the next one without reading the whole history.

post.summary: Issue a one-time realtime connection ticket
post.description: Mints a single-use ticket for the current session. The client sends it as the first WebSocket frame to the realtime service and never places it in a URL. The ticket expires within seconds and authenticates at most one socket. `user_id` is the account the ticket belongs to. Returns 503 `realtime_disabled` when realtime is turned off and 503 `realtime_unavailable` when it is temporarily unavailable.

CounselingEncounterOrdering.title: CounselingEncounterOrdering

targets.description: Parts of the Inventory the Counselor asked the Student to review, in catalog order. Empty when the request named none.
targets.title: Targets

ContextHistoryStatus.description:
Per-kind history states: Appointment status, Referral receipt, Call Slip interview end,
Routine Intake submission, and VOIDED for voided Referrals and Call Slips.
ContextHistoryStatus.title: ContextHistoryStatus

InventoryRosterOrdering.description: Closed Individual Inventory roster orderings (ADR-090); the roster is a Student directory.
InventoryRosterOrdering.title: InventoryRosterOrdering

reason.description: Student-visible correction guidance explaining what must be corrected before resubmission.
reason.title: Reason

targets.description: Optional parts of the Inventory for the Student to review. Advisory only; repeats are dropped and the stored order follows the catalog.
targets.title: Targets

GoodMoralOrdering.description:
Closed operational Good Moral orderings (ADR-090).

Chronology is the time a request reached its current status: requested, ready for issuance,
issued, or cancelled. Requested and ready requests are queues and default to the oldest
waiting; issued and cancelled ones are history and default to the newest.
GoodMoralOrdering.title: GoodMoralOrdering

FeedbackResponseOrdering.description: Closed orderings for submitted Feedback and CSM responses (ADR-090); newest first.
FeedbackResponseOrdering.title: FeedbackResponseOrdering

GraduateTracerOrdering.description: Closed orderings for submitted Graduate Tracer responses (ADR-090); newest first.
GraduateTracerOrdering.title: GraduateTracerOrdering

rating.description: Numeric source response. Value 0 is preserved without a fabricated semantic label.
rating.title: Rating

targets.description: Parts of the Exit Interview Head Guidance asked the Student to review, in catalog order. Empty for requests that named none, including every earlier request.
targets.title: Targets

rating.description: Source Page 2 visibly permits numeric 0; the source does not define its meaning.
rating.title: Rating

ExitInterviewOrdering.description:
Closed operational Exit Interview orderings (ADR-090).

Submitted Exit Interviews read as history by their latest submission. Drafts and mixed lists
follow the last update, which is what changes while a Student is still working.
ExitInterviewOrdering.title: ExitInterviewOrdering

reason.description: Student-visible correction guidance explaining what must be corrected before resubmission.
reason.title: Reason

targets.description: Optional parts of the Exit Interview for the Student to review. Advisory only; each must exist on the record's saved Form Revision. Repeats are dropped and the stored order follows the catalog.
targets.title: Targets

RoutineInventoryContext.description:
The submitted Individual Inventory bound when the Routine Interview began (ADR-088).

It identifies that annual record; it is not a frozen copy. While the record is reopened for
correction, ``available`` is false and its draft values are withheld.
RoutineInventoryContext.title: RoutineInventoryContext

RoutineInterviewOrdering.description:
Closed orderings for a Counselor's assigned Routine Interviews (ADR-090).

Pending evaluations are an action queue: waiting is measured from intake submission, so newer
submissions never bury older unfinished evaluations.
RoutineInterviewOrdering.title: RoutineInterviewOrdering

ReferralOrdering.description:
Closed Referral orderings (ADR-090).

``referred_on`` is the canonical chronology: the date on the Referral, which the date filters
also use. Entry time breaks ties, so back-entered Referrals sit at their real date.
ReferralOrdering.title: ReferralOrdering

CallSlipOrdering.description:
Closed Call Slip orderings (ADR-090).

``report_at`` is when the Student is expected to report. Active Call Slips are a schedule and
default to the earliest report time; completed, voided, and mixed lists are history and
default to the latest.
CallSlipOrdering.title: CallSlipOrdering

NotificationTargetType.description: Closed set of in-app destinations a Notification may point at.
NotificationTargetType.title: NotificationTargetType

optional_email_enabled.description: Controls only OPTIONAL_INFORMATIONAL email. Mandatory security and operational email is not disabled by this preference.
optional_email_enabled.title: Optional Email Enabled

AnnouncementManagementOrdering.description: Closed orderings for Announcement management (ADR-090); recent edits come first.
AnnouncementManagementOrdering.title: AnnouncementManagementOrdering

AnnouncementOrdering.description:
Closed reader orderings (ADR-090).

RECOMMENDED is the editorial order: pinned first, then the newest published. The other values
let a reader browse the full index in another order; Overview always uses RECOMMENDED.
AnnouncementOrdering.title: AnnouncementOrdering

ResourceManagementOrdering.description: Closed orderings for Resource management (ADR-090); recent edits come first.
ResourceManagementOrdering.title: ResourceManagementOrdering

ResourceOrdering.description:
Closed reader orderings (ADR-090).

RECOMMENDED is the curated order: ``display_order`` first, then the newest published. The
other values let a reader browse the full library in another order.
ResourceOrdering.title: ResourceOrdering

EmailDeliveryOrdering.description:
Closed EmailDelivery orderings (ADR-090).

Pending, processing, and failed deliveries are operational work and default to the oldest
first, like the summary's "oldest pending". Sent, cancelled, and unfiltered lists are history
and default to the newest first.
EmailDeliveryOrdering.title: EmailDeliveryOrdering

EmailDeliveryFailureCode.description: Closed, provider-neutral failure classification exposed to operators.
EmailDeliveryFailureCode.title: EmailDeliveryFailureCode

EmailDeliveryRetryBlocker.description: Why a delivery is not currently eligible for one manual retry.
EmailDeliveryRetryBlocker.title: EmailDeliveryRetryBlocker

NoticePublishBlocker.description: Server-owned reasons a notice revision cannot be published right now.
NoticePublishBlocker.title: NoticePublishBlocker

ECounselingConsentStatus.description: Workspace consent projection; WITHDRAWN derives from an approved, withdrawn decision.
ECounselingConsentStatus.title: ECounselingConsentStatus

GuidanceTemplateResponse.title: GuidanceTemplateResponse

GuidanceAppointmentContext.description: Structural only: never a Message body, preview or participant directory.
GuidanceAppointmentContext.title: GuidanceAppointmentContext

GuidanceHandlerOption.description: A safe staff label for assignment: no email, capability, designation or supervision.
GuidanceHandlerOption.title: GuidanceHandlerOption

OpaqueSessionAuth.name: compass_session
